title.narrative: Effective responses to drug-resistant tuberculosis in Kazakhstan

description.narrative: Kazakhstan - Tuberculosis - RSE on REU “National Scientific Center of Phthisiopulmonology of the Republic of Kazakhstan” of the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Kazakhstan - RSE on REU “NSCP RK" MH RK. This program has the following goals: To strengthen comprehensive and sustainable health system and communities responses to DS and DR-TB challenges in Kazakhstan sustained through people-centered and evidence-based approaches, including those for vulnerable and at-risk populations. The objectives of this program are: To sustain universal access to quality and people-centered DS and DR-TB diagnosis, treatment, prevention and M&E
